runs.summary: I rebuilt and checked T-456 from scratch and it's back in review with Adi and Bharath. I found and fixed one gap, and the guides are still not pushed.

decisions.decision: Build it now in tantra-redesign. Write revops-os/build/gen_task_guides.py. It reads revops-os/tasks/day0-3 JSON (day2a and day2b too), the 113 #task-<card id> sections in workshop-plan/playbook.html and the card metadata. For every card it writes revops-os/tasks/<taskCode>-<id>.md with: purpose, the inputs it reads from context/, steps, the api.mjs calls and their confirm flags, the deliverables in outputs/, acceptance checks, the chat-edition steps, and links to knowledge/ (missing links get T-455 stubs). Human-only cards get a short guide marked 'no prompt'. Follow COPY_RULES voice and approved-vendor-stack (no banned tools). Add revops-os/scripts/check-task-guides.mjs. It should check one guide per card, required sections, resolving links, no BANNED tools and no dashes. Run it until it passes, commit, push, and move the task to review.
decisions.why: Plan REVOPS_OS_PLAN_2026_10_15 row T-456 defines the guide file and done_when. revops-os/tasks/ holds only the day JSONs and no guides or check script yet. This is pure build work on our own repo, so Adi has nothing to provide.

decisions.decision: The guides already exist and need verifying, not rebuilding. revops-os/build.py writes them to dist/tantra-revops-os/tasks/dayN/<code>-<id>.md (Day 0 to Day 2 plus Day 3), and revops-os/scripts/check-task-guides.mjs exists. Now: (1) run node app/scripts/export-os-cards.mjs && python3 revops-os/build.py && node revops-os/scripts/check-task-guides.mjs. (2) Fix every problem it reports in revops-os/tasks/*.json or build.py, never by hand-editing dist. Problems include a missing guide, a missing section, a broken link, a banned vendor, a dash, or a wrong outputs/ code. Re-run until it reports 0 problems. (3) Run os/scripts/check-refs.mjs as well, which is T-455's done_when. (4) Commit and push the generator, check script, task data and dist. (5) Move T-456 to review. Post the check output, guide count and commit hash as evidence, and add a note on T-455 saying its refs check was re-run.
decisions.why: The 2026-10-18 proceed decision has been built. The repo holds check-task-guides.mjs (T-456), the build.py generator and 136 guide files in dist. The task status was never moved off queue. The done_when (one guide per card, check passes) only needs a passing run.
